audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart hands Gwen 6 of 7 stages while the win rate on disk is 51.9% for Trundle, and the chart directly contradicts the prose sitting next to it — whys[0] through whys[3] all describe Trundle winning those exact stages ('you are the aggressor', 'set your power island right on top of her', 'run her down inside Frozen Domain').
audit.why: A 51.9% lane cannot be a 6-1 loss on the chart, and the two halves of the same page must not disagree. The correct shape is Trundle winning levels 1 through 5 and Gwen taking over from 6 on scaling, which is exactly what the whys already say.
audit.corrected: win[0..3] set to Trundle, win[4] set to Gwen; matching phases[0..4].side and ratings in the full layer.
sources: the whys array in the same entry

audit.why: Spike order is right — your level 3 Q+W+E window, her level 6 Needlework, her Riftmaker first item, her two-item true damage. Only the timings were missing, and those are added below.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors repeated across three fields. (a) 'Hallowed Mist blocks your Pillar terrain' — it does not; Pillar of Ice is a ground-placed cast and the terrain spawns inside the mist regardless. What Mist actually blocks is Subjugate, which is a target-selected ability, plus every ranged ally outside the cloud. (b) Chomp is credited with an attack-speed steal or 'AS debuff' twice. Chomp saps Attack Damage only; the attack speed in this matchup is yours, from Frozen Domain.
audit.why: Riot text: Hallowed Mist — 'she can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist'. Subjugate — 'steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance' (targeted, 650 range). Pillar of Ice — 'creates an ice pillar at target location'. Chomp — 'dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage'.
audit.corrected: Mist reframed as an outside-only shield you walk through, Pillar explicitly stated to work inside it, and every attack-speed-steal claim replaced with the AD drain.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags this matchup as having no cooldown-sequencing advice, and no number appears anywhere in the entry.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s, Skip 'n Slash is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s and only partially refunds if she connects during it, Needlework is 120/100/80s. Your own Pillar at 21s rank 1 is almost exactly Mist's cooldown, which is the cleanest sequencing cue in the lane.
audit.corrected: Added the 22s Mist, 13s Skip 'n Slash refund condition, and the 100s cost of throwing Subjugate into a Mist.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing despite Gwen healing off her passive on every auto.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts: 'She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.' Frozen Domain also amplifies healing from all sources for you, so Grievous Wounds is doubly decisive here — it cuts her passive drain and your W-amplified regen at once.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[2] now states the passive heal and names Grievous Wounds as the counter.

edits.before: At levels 1-2 you are the aggressor — Q Chomp into every auto trade steals her attack damage and heals you off nearby minion deaths, and Gwen has no defensive tools yet. Walk her off the wave, deny CS, and if she tries to snip back, pop Frozen Domain immediately so the AS steal gap widens with every tick. She cannot out-sustain you here and her E dash is short enough that Pillar cuts it off if she tries to disengage. Bank these leads hard because the window closes faster than almost any other matchup.
edits.after: At levels 1-2 you are the aggressor — Q Chomp into every auto trade saps her attack damage and King's Tribute heals you off nearby minion deaths, and Gwen has no defensive tool yet. Walk her off the wave, deny CS, and if she snips back, drop Frozen Domain immediately: the W is where your attack speed and healing come from, Chomp only drains her AD. Skip 'n Slash is short enough that Pillar cuts the exit. Bank these leads hard, because this window closes faster than in almost any other matchup.

edits.before: W Frozen Domain comes online and you can set your power island right on top of her; she has no dash yet to escape the AS debuff stacking on Chomp.
edits.after: W Frozen Domain comes online and you can set your power island right on top of her; she has no dash yet to escape the AD drain Chomp stacks on her.

edits.before: Hallowed Mist blocks your Pillar terrain and your Subjugate stat-drain if she activates it on cast, and Needlework stitches you in place for her true-damage Q to shred through the armor you stole.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist eats Subjugate outright if she times it — R is a targeted cast — and Needlework then slows you for the centre line of Snip Snip!, whose true damage ignores the armor you stole.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you still control trades as long as you prevent her from stepping into Hallowed Mist range and building E stacks. Keep her on the back foot with Pillar denying her preferred angle, then walk her into Frozen Domain and stack Chomp's AD drain — without her W bubble she has no real answer to extended fighting here. At level 6 the math reverses: her Needlework stitches you in place inside the mist and her Q true damage bypasses the armor you just stole with Subjugate, so if she activates Hallowed Mist on your R cast you will lose that all-in. Either get the kill before she presses W, or bank the lead and defer the fight.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you still control trades as long as you keep her off free Skip 'n Slash resets — the 13s dash only refunds part of itself if she connects during it. Keep her on the back foot with Pillar denying her angle, then walk her into Frozen Domain and stack Chomp's AD drain; without the mist up she has no answer to extended fighting. At level 6 the math reverses: Needlework slows you and the centre line of Snip Snip! is true damage that ignores stolen armor. Mist only shields her from outside, so step inside and Chomp lands again — but a 100-second Subjugate thrown into a Mist is a lost all-in. Kill her before she presses W, or defer.

edits.before: At two items Gwen's true damage and percent-current-HP Q output simply outpaces whatever Subjugate drained onto you — she does not care that you have her armor because she deals damage that ignores armor entirely. Hallowed Mist also blocks your Pillar and any jungle follow-up, so she can 1v1 you and 1v2 you at the same time. Your win condition in the late game is not the solo duel; it is converting your early lead into objective control, funneling Subjugate onto the tankiest front-liner on their team in 5v5s, and never letting Gwen reach a free side-lane where Mist makes her unkillable.
edits.after: At two items Gwen's centre-line true damage outpaces whatever Subjugate drained onto you — holding her armor does not matter against damage that ignores armor. Hallowed Mist does not stop Pillar of Ice, which is ground-placed and spawns inside the cloud regardless, but it does deny Subjugate and every ranged ally standing outside, so she fights you and your jungler at once. Your late win condition is not the solo duel; it is converting the early lead into objectives, saving Subjugate for their tankiest frontliner in 5v5s, and never handing Gwen a free side lane.

edits.before: At two items Gwen's true damage and percent-current-HP Q shred through the armor Subjugate steals, and Hallowed Mist blocks your Pillar and any allied follow-up.
edits.after: At two items the centre line of Snip Snip! shreds past any armor Subjugate steals, and an 18-second Hallowed Mist denies R and every ranged ally follow-up.

edits.before: Use Pillar of Ice to cut off her E dash escape when she tries to skirt your W zone and reset
edits.after: Pillar her Skip 'n Slash exit — the 13s dash only refunds if she connects during it

edits.before: Activate Hallowed Mist the instant you Subjugate or Pillar so your drain and terrain both whiff
edits.after: Pop Hallowed Mist the instant Subjugate is cast — R is targeted, so the whole 100s drain whiffs

edits.before: Reach two items so her Q true damage and percent-HP shred bypass every resistance you drained onto yourself
edits.after: Heal off A Thousand Cuts (P) on every auto, so a Trundle with no Grievous Wounds can never out-sustain her

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — 22s, and safe only from outside. Step in and Chomp lands again.

notes: Disk says 51.9% / 158 games; the packet says 44.55% / 110 and flags the level chart as contradicting the data — it does, but in the opposite direction from what the packet assumed. I reconciled against the disk win rate and against the entry's own whys, which unambiguously describe Trundle winning levels 1-5. Left alone: full.tone is #ff5d6c (the HARD colour) while full.diff says EVEN — the same pairing is #e8b84b on other EVEN matchups, so one of the two is wrong, but I did not want to guess which the renderer keys off. Chomp does not steal attack speed anywhere in Riot's text; that same fabrication also appears in trundle vs gnar (wants.you[0], spikes[3].text) and is fixed in a follow-up edit there.
